description: Wraith Wallet - desktop wallet for Bitcoin Ghost (light wallet + Wraith CoinJoin + Ghost Locks + TAP payments).
notes: This MSI is unsigned by a commercial CA (no paid Authenticode cert, by design). SmartScreen may warn 'unknown publisher' - that is expected.
The real trust anchor is the GPG-signed SHA256SUMS on the release. Scoop also verifies the 'hash' below on download and aborts on any mismatch.
wraithd (the daemon) keeps running after you close the GUI window. Use the wraith CLI 'wraith ...' or the tray menu to manage it.
_comment: TEMPLATE - a release step must fill the real per-release sha256 in architecture.64bit.hash (from the SHA256SUMS asset); do NOT ship an invented hash. The MSI bundles only the GUI (renamed to productName, 'Wraith Wallet.exe') and the wraithd sidecar ('wraithd.exe') - the 'wraith' CLI is NOT bundled. Confirm those two exe basenames against the first real MSI's extracted layout (Tauri may emit 'wraith-gui.exe' if it does not rename to productName) and adjust shortcuts/bin accordingly. The '#/wraith-wallet.msi' URL fragment gives Scoop a clean local filename despite the spaces-to-dots asset name.
